name: SWE-rebench
description: SWE-rebench is a large-scale, automated, and continuously updated benchmark and dataset for interactive software engineering tasks, extracted from real-world GitHub repositories. It contains over 21,000 Python-based interactive tasks designed to evaluate and train software engineering agents, addressing contamination and freshness issues in existing benchmarks.
reputation: A recent large-scale benchmark for interactive software engineering agents that is positioned as a fresher, more contamination-resistant alternative to older SWE-style benchmarks.
notes: Focuses on contamination-free evaluation and real-world interactive SWE tasks; suitable for reinforcement learning of SWE agents.
